claim_verdicts.evidence: git show stage-1:DonHang.Domain/IOrderRepository.cs lines 5-11: `public interface IOrderRepository { Task<Order?> FindAsync(int id); Task<List<Order>> ListByCustomerAsync(int customerId); Task AddAsync(Order order); Task SaveChangesAsync(); }`, namespace DonHang.Domain. Code block in section 5 matches character-for-character (re-checked round 2).

git show stage-1:DonHang.Infrastructure/EfOrderRepository.cs lines 7-19: primary constructor `(DonHangDbContext db)`; FindAsync = `db.Orders.Include(o => o.Items).FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.Id == id)`; ListByCustomerAsync = `Where(...).Include(o => o.Customer).OrderBy(o => o.Id).ToListAsync()`; AddAsync awaits `db.Orders.AddAsync`; SaveChangesAsync => `db.SaveChangesAsync()`. Block matches exactly; supports "thin wrapper around one EF Core query or call".
OrderService.cs @ stage-1 calls only repository.AddAsync, repository.SaveChangesAsync, repository.FindAsync (three of four; never ListByCustomerAsync); no using of Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.

FakeOrderRepository.cs: `public sealed class FakeOrderRepository : IOrderRepository { private readonly Dictionary<int, Order> orders = []; ...` implements all four methods. OrderServiceTests.cs: `new FakeOrderRepository()` passed to `new OrderService(repository, notifier)`; no DbContext or connection string.

Commit 4fca60a "feat: add Order.Customer navigation + GET /api/v1/orders for N+1 lesson": body lists "IOrderRepository.ListByCustomerAsync + EfOrderRepository implementation ... and the matching FakeOrderRepository" and "GET /api/v1/orders (OrdersController)". EfOrderRepository.cs:12 `// lesson: backend.l1.efcore-n-plus-one` sits on that method, supporting the section 5 sentence about the comment.

interfaces.md:35: "The class must provide an implementation for every member declared in the interface"; :86: "...must provide implementations for all declared members (unless the interface provides a default implementation)." None of the four IOrderRepository members has a body, so the lesson's "every method its interface declares — here, all four" and the ledger's conditioned form both hold.

single-split-queries.md: "When working against relational databases, EF loads related entities by introducing JOINs into a single query." and "EF Core uses single query mode by default in the absence of any configuration." Repo @ stage-1 has no UseQuerySplittingBehavior/AsSplitQuery; ServiceCollectionExtensions only calls UseNpgsql(connectionString).
Definitional: restates the glossary/outline definition of repository and describes IOrderRepository as it exists; no behaviour, number or syntax asserted.
OrderService.cs @ stage-1: `var order = await repository.FindAsync(orderId) ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"order {orderId} not found");`

OrdersController.cs @ stage-1: ctor `(OrderService orderService, IOrderRepository repository)`; Get: `await repository.FindAsync(id)`; List: `await repository.ListByCustomerAsync(customerId)`; neither calls orderService. Next lesson outline item 2 covers the shortcut.

ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs @ stage-1: `services.AddDbContext<DonHangDbContext>(options => options.UseNpgsql(connectionString)); services.AddScoped<IOrderRepository, EfOrderRepository>();`. Program.cs: `builder.Services.AddDonHangInfrastructure(connectionString); builder.Services.AddScoped<OrderService>();`.

DonHangDbContext.cs @ stage-1 declares exactly six DbSets (Customers, Products, Orders, OrderItems, Payments, Notifications), each mapped by ToTable to its own table. DonHang.Domain.csproj @ stage-1 has only a PropertyGroup (net10.0, ImplicitUsings, Nullable, RootNamespace): no PackageReference, no ProjectReference. OrderService.cs is in DonHang.Domain.
